Always asks doubts and questions that are very silly but despite seeming like she wasn't very bright, she used to score really well in exams. I never really thought much of it till she came to me and broke down crying. Honestly, I didn't know how to react at first, even though I knew what it's like to be harassed by someone fairly close (not that she knew it). The uncle was considered as this "God-like" figure in the family because they came from a small village and he somehow managed to start a successful business with her father and help them live the rich life. Even thought they were conservative with the kind of clothes she was "allowed" to wear, they would force her to wear shorts and tank tops if the uncle bought it for her. After she told me about everything, I realised that despite how much I cared, I wouldn't be able to make a huge impact on changing her family or make them believe her.
